tier1.text: The skull protects the brain and supports the face. The skull is made of 22 bones that form the head, face and jaws. In adults, 21 of these bones are locked into one unit, but the lower jaw can move. The locked bones meet at sutures, fixed joints filled with dense, fibrous tissue.

quotes.quote: The cranium (skull) is the skeletal structure of the head that supports the face and protects the brain.

sentences.text: The skull is made of 22 bones that form the head, face and jaws.

quotes.quote: skull: bony structure that forms the head, face, and jaws, and protects the brain; consists of 22 bones
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: In adults, 21 of these bones are locked into one unit, but the lower jaw can move.

quotes.quote: In the adult, the skull consists of 22 individual bones, 21 of which are immobile and united into a single unit. The 22nd bone is the mandible (lower jaw), which is the only moveable bone of the skull.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The locked bones meet at sutures, fixed joints filled with dense, fibrous tissue.

quotes.quote: A suture is an immobile joint between adjacent bones of the skull. The narrow gap between the bones is filled with dense, fibrous connective tissue that unites the bones.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
